title: Autoregressive stream-of-thought prefrontal (replace atomic step)
description: Replace one-JSON-per-cycle prefrontal with a thought-unit generator that produces a stream. Each step conditioned on (a) full prior thought chain, (b) current AffectState, (c) workspace broadcasts. Regions still tick between units: DMN can hijack the stream (a tangent becomes the next thought), amygdala interrupt yanks focus, body signals derail. Chain commits when a unit's kind is 'action' or 'finish'. ThoughtUnit lives on Workspace.
close_reason: autoregressive stream-of-thought prefrontal implemented; offline tests pass (incl. DMN hijack intrusion test); live smoke shows 0.977 Jaccard divergence vs raw model on same prompt — humanization mechanism demonstrably producing non-AI reactions

title: World model (LeCun-style) on embedding backend + PFC integration + REM counterfactuals
description: brain/world_model.py: SQLite-backed WorldModelStore that observes (state, action, outcome) triples and predicts outcomes by embedding-space k-NN. Uses the same pluggable EmbeddingBackend so 'auto' yields real embeddings when available, TF-IDF otherwise. PFC consults it when generating action thought-units (learned expected_result from past similar situations). Orchestrator writes an observation after every executed action — passive learning. Dreamer (REM) samples (state, action, outcome) triples and asks LLM for counterfactuals ('what if you had done Y instead'), writes back as tags=['counterfactual'] semantic facts. Cerebellum region is a separate follow-up.
close_reason: world model shipped: k-NN over (state, action, outcome) on configured embedding backend; PFC consults via speculative-action query; orchestrator observes after every action with surprise-scaled salience; dreamer gains counterfactual lane during REM. 44/44 tests pass. Commit fb4b67d.

title: Sleep daemon: always-on WAKE/DROWSY/NREM/REM state machine + sleep agents
description: Long-lived event loop. State machine driven by AffectState.fatigue + World.hour + idle_time + input. WAKE = stream-of-thought on input (or rate-limited spontaneous thought). DROWSY = transition. NREM = consolidator + forgetter + skill_pruner + mood_regulator. REM = dreamer (creative recombination of distant memories). Always-on scheduler agent fires time-based prospective triggers. CLI: python -m brain.daemon. Brain.run(task) stays as the sync single-task entry. Sleep agents live under brain/sleep/.
close_reason: sleep daemon shipped: WAKE/DROWSY/NREM/REM state machine, 5 sleep agents (dreamer, forgetter, skill_pruner, mood_regulator, scheduler), persistent affect across tasks, CLI; 39/39 tests pass; commit ad1f198

title: Pluggable embedding backend (replace TF-IDF as default when configured)
description: Abstract EmbeddingBackend interface in brain/embeddings.py. Three backends: TfidfBackend (current behavior, no deps), OpenRouterBackend (HTTP /embeddings), LocalSentenceTransformersBackend (optional, if installed). Memory.retrieve_semantic delegates through it. Embedding cache as BLOB column on episodes; precompute lazily. Config: memory.embedding_backend, memory.embedding_model. Defaults preserve current behavior (tfidf) so no breakage.
close_reason: pluggable embedding backend shipped; 32/32 tests pass; commit 4ca8fe3

title: Typed memory: episodic/semantic/prospective/affect + tfidf + consolidation
description: Promote hippocampus from one-bucket keyword recall to typed memory subsystems. Add mem_type column (episodic|semantic|prospective|affect|source), pure-python TF-IDF semantic retrieval (no new deps), prospective_memory table with trigger matching at sensory cortex, end-of-task consolidation pass that clusters episodic rows and extracts recurring patterns as semantic facts via LLM, and a brain.consolidator CLI for offline 'sleep' consolidation across accumulated runs. Memory stays LLM-free; the consolidator owns the LLM call.
close_reason: typed memory + TF-IDF + prospective + consolidator shipped; 28/28 offline tests pass; commit 33900b5

title: Habit cache (System-1 skills) + predictive-coding hook
description: Two coupled changes for inter-region realism + System-2→System-1 skill compilation. (1) SkillStore in basal ganglia: cache (percept_signature → effector+args) tuples after N successes; BG fires habits directly (no PFC LLM call) when stress/fatigue high AND no recent surprise AND no amygdala interrupt. (2) Predictive coding: PFC emits expected_result with action; orchestrator computes trigram surprise vs actual; high surprise spikes LC arousal, posts a prediction_error broadcast, breaks habit-fire on next cycle. Stale-habit failure mode: confidence decays on miss, no fire below threshold.
close_reason: habit cache + predictive-coding loop implemented; 21/21 offline tests pass; commit 8588e38

title: Loadable persona - prior facts that implicitly define traits + seed memory
description: A YAML/JSON 'persona' file with biographical facts (name, age, occupation, history, relationships, hobbies, dispositions, recent events). At brain init: (a) facts pre-seeded into Hippocampus so they surface via retrieve; (b) traits derived implicitly from fact tags (or explicit overrides) → Traits anchor on AffectState; (c) initial affect tinted by recent-event tone.

title: Modulate existing regions by AffectState (prompt-level only)
description: Per CLAUDE.md: change behavior via system prompt + step(), not workspace. Each region reads AffectState and threads it into its prompt: prefrontal becomes risk-averse under stress, impulsive under high reward+low PFC; basal ganglia loosens vetoes under high arousal; hippocampus does mood-congruent recall; broca colors output tone.

title: Build World harness - ambient environment ticker
description: A World object that ticks in parallel with the cognitive loop: time-of-day, weather, notifications, social messages, physiological drift (hunger++, fatigue++). Emits ambient broadcasts the sensory cortex can pull in. Configurable scenarios: 'monday morning', 'deadline night', 'boring tuesday afternoon'.

title: Add Default Mode Network region - mind-wandering & distractions
description: DMN injects task-unrelated broadcasts: intrusive memories, self-referential rumination, hypotheticals. Frequency scales with boredom/fatigue, inversely with arousal. This is the primary mechanism that makes the brain diverge from the raw LLM.

title: Add persistent AffectState to Workspace (mood, arousal, valence, drives)
description: Currently amygdala appraises per-cycle but state does not persist. Add a typed AffectState (valence, arousal, mood, fatigue, hunger, boredom, social_need, curiosity, stress) that lives on Workspace, decays/updates each cycle, and is rendered into region prompts. Boundary-safe: regions only read it.
close_reason: AffectState + Workspace integration done; arousal-modulated attention, distractibility-gated DMN selection, affect rendered into prompts

title: Stream-of-thought multi-step demo + latency tuning
description: Build a demo that exercises the autoregressive chain on a multi-step prompt across two scenarios; capture full thought chain + call counts + latency; tune _RECALL_EVERY/_WORLD_EVERY/max_cycles defaults based on observed cost.
close_reason: multi-step stream demo working; effector guard added (prevents invented verbs); default max_cycles lowered to 8 (better suited to stream-of-thought). Live: 12-13 calls per scenario, deadline_night shows ~1.5x DMN fires vs calm_morning, chain unfolds with visible intrusions/recovery, final text colored by mood

title: Run config + scenario presets
description: Add humanize.yaml or extend config.yaml with personality (trait anchors: neuroticism, extraversion, conscientiousness, openness), scenarios, and humanization toggle so the same brain can run vanilla or humanized for direct comparison.

title: Humanization eval - measure divergence from raw model under affect perturbations
description: New eval/humanize.py: run a battery of prompts (ethically loaded choices, mood-sensitive prompts, time-pressure tasks, social-context tasks) under (a) raw model, (b) brain-vanilla, (c) brain-humanized × {calm, stressed, fatigued, distracted}. Metrics: lexical/embedding divergence vs raw, distraction rate (% cycles with off-task spotlight), action-choice variance under same task, refusal/sycophancy modulation, mood-coloring of broca output.
close_reason: autoregressive stream-of-thought prefrontal implemented; offline tests pass (incl. DMN hijack intrusion test); live smoke shows 0.977 Jaccard divergence vs raw model on same prompt — humanization mechanism demonstrably producing non-AI reactions

title: Add Locus Coeruleus + VTA (neuromodulators)
description: LC sets arousal/attention width (high arousal narrows attention, low arousal widens). VTA sets reward tone / motivation that modulates basal ganglia gating thresholds. Both write to AffectState; don't directly call other regions.

title: Add Interoception (insula) region - body→affect
description: New region that reads body state from the World (hunger, fatigue, ambient stress) and posts to AffectState. Models bottom-up bodily contribution to emotion.
